purpose: measure ground-truth visibility, model detection, confirmatory-gate sensitivity, materiality-gate attrition, bounded discovery sensitivity and full-pipeline specificity for small noisy sparse conditional edge before B2-06 scientific execution

diagnostic_meaning.GROUND_TRUTH_VISIBLE: ground-truth-aware diagnostic only: injected support-conditional mean shift has frozen block-bootstrap lower bound above zero; never visible to discovery selection
diagnostic_meaning.MODEL_DETECTED: candidate has positive pooled incremental prediction, frozen block-bootstrap lower bound above zero, and placebo separation; materiality and era-stability are not required
diagnostic_meaning.STRICT_PASS_EX_MATERIALITY: primary_positive AND bootstrap_positive AND placebo_separation AND era_stability AND support_sanity
diagnostic_meaning.STRICT_PASS: STRICT_PASS_EX_MATERIALITY AND unchanged pooled relative-MAE >= 0.02 gate

ORACLE_CONFIRMATORY.question: given the correct candidate feature without privileged support metadata, identify where visibility-to-model-to-confirmation-to-materiality loses power

BLIND_LIBRARY_DISCOVERY.question: within a bounded preregistered library, calibrate the full search-select-evaluate process and distinguish true, proxy, pure-false and no-discovery outcomes

dgp.independence: U1, U2, mechanism transition uniforms and RAW innovations are mutually independent within a world; world/auxiliary streams are namespaced

baseline.realism_limitation: V1 does not calibrate candidate absorption of baseline-model misspecification

effect_scale_reference.ceiling_interpretation: the unchanged 2 percent pooled materiality gate is expected to be unreachable for the stationary positive ladder even under ideal oracle prediction; this mismatch is a calibration target, not a reason to alter beta or the gate
effect_scale_reference.scale_matched_materiality_metric: MATERIALITY_FRACTION_OF_ATTAINABLE = observed_RELATIVE_MAE_IMPROVEMENT / asymptotic_max_relative_mae_improvement_approx; unavailable for nonpositive denominator

monte_carlo.failed_world_policy: failed worlds remain in denominator and make the aggregate INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION unless exact frozen execution is reproduced before result opening

metrics.SUPPORT_COVERAGE: mean(TRUE_TRIGGER==1) on scored rows; truth-aware reporting only
metrics.EFFECTIVE_SUPPORT_N: report design-effect estimate from trigger autocorrelation together with raw positive count; diagnostic only, never a gate

ground_truth_visibility.truth_access: artifact-generation diagnostic only; forbidden to candidate fitting, discovery selection, placebo and tie-breaking

strict_reference_gate.era_stability: mean_AE_improvement > 0 in at least 3 of 4 scored eras
strict_reference_gate.support_sanity: candidate feature positive count among scored rows is finite, nonzero, >=50; for ORACLE F03 this equals realized trigger support; discovery candidates use their own candidate-positive count
strict_reference_gate.STRICT_PASS_EX_MATERIALITY: primary_positive AND bootstrap_positive AND placebo_separation AND era_stability AND support_sanity

bootstrap.sampling: whole contiguous blocks with replacement; no block crosses era

placebo.operation: permute evaluated candidate labels separately within each scored era; Y/X1/X2/order fixed; refit the same expanding-era procedure

discovery.selection: among STRICT_PASS_EX_MATERIALITY candidates select max MEAN_AE_IMPROVEMENT; exact ties ascending feature_id; none=>NO_CANDIDATE
discovery.NULL_false_positive: ANY_EDGE_DECLARED under NULL after the complete search-select-evaluate pipeline
discovery.scope: bounded discovery calibration only, not independent confirmatory validation

acceptance.detection_floor: classify VISIBILITY_FLOOR when GROUND_TRUTH_VISIBLE Wilson upper <0.50; otherwise MODEL_FLOOR when MODEL_DETECTION Wilson upper <0.50; otherwise ABOVE_MEASURED_FLOOR
acceptance.materiality_diagnostic: report STRICT_PASS versus STRICT_PASS_EX_MATERIALITY and MATERIALITY_FRACTION_OF_ATTAINABLE; STRICT_PASS is not the sole calibration success variable

b2_06_consequences.visibility_floor: comparable negative market results cannot strongly establish absence of edge
b2_06_consequences.model_floor: model/evaluation sensitivity requires repair or explicit power caveat before interpreting comparable NO_PROMOTION
b2_06_consequences.materiality_only_failure: record that the 2 percent pooled materiality criterion suppresses otherwise detectable sparse structure; calibration itself does not authorize changing any market gate
b2_06_consequences.indeterminate: no binary methodology claim and no threshold tuning from the same calibration outcomes

anti_rescue: no lowering 2 percent materiality threshold after outcomes
no switching which diagnostic layer drives a conclusion after outcomes
no dropping hard worlds or failed worlds
no post-result candidate addition or proxy reclassification
execution_ceremony: implementation written using synthetic fixture tests only
implementation independently reviewed without production grid execution
any methodology change requires a new version
